hook.label: Hook
hook.title: Cold-open hook mode — applies ReelShort 4-panel × 2s structure (Wide → Medium → OTS → Slow push-in). Auto mode infers style from the group text.

frameLock.label: Frame lock
frameLock.tipReady: First-frame lock — use SHOT 01 image as first frame; selecting "first+last" also uses the final panel's image as last frame. Kling 3.0 i2v single-shot (5-15s) — gives up multi-shot for pixel-level character/scene consistency.
frameLock.tipNeedImage: Frame lock needs SHOT 01 image generated first — generate from timeline/gallery first

options.firstLastNeedImage: Lock first+last · needs SHOT {n} image too

duration.label: Duration
duration.tipAuto: Auto = estimated {n}s from group dialogue length (Chinese ~4 chars/sec, English ~2.3 words/sec; with no dialogue uses max(10, panels × 2.5)). Picking 5/10/15 overrides manually.
duration.tipManual: AUTO mode lets the worker allocate per-shot seconds from dialogue; picking 5/10/15 splits evenly to that total

style.label: Style
style.title: Picking a style overrides this group's project default (visualStyleId). Worker injects the style's styleAnchor + visualModifiers around each multi_prompt segment.

frameLockPreview.modeHint: · This group runs single-shot i2v (5-15s); multi-shot paused
frameLockPreview.klingDescMid: , with 5-15 seconds in between driven by the narrative prompt above. Best for
frameLockPreview.klingDescEnd: — groups needing pixel-level consistency. To return to multi-shot, set "Frame lock" above back to Off.
frameLockPreview.unlockHint: 💡 Want "Frame lock" (Kling 3.0 i2v pixel lock)? Generate an image for SHOT 01 from the timeline/gallery first and this option unlocks.
